liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Music Never Stopped** (3 reviews): Bob and Donna goof around before the tempo change, which the reviewer found fun; First set has huge versions of this, Ramble On Rose and Cassidy [7][11][16]
- **Stayin' Alive Tease** (2 other sources): A Stayin' Alive tease occurs inside Big River; Another Stayin' Alive tease appears in Big River [3][4]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Lead break shakes with intensity; after the last verse the floor drops out into quiet noodling, then Fire; At the transition into Fire, Bobby and Jerry interplay in total sync after a flurry from Jerry [7][9]
- **Fire on the Mountain** (2 reviews): Bobby plays dual lead alongside Jerry, a rare moment in the reviewer's experience; Bobby plays aggressively like a second lead guitarist, and Jerry competes with him [9][17]
- **Werewolves of London** (2 reviews): The encore is described as an out-of-tune mess; Reviewer calls it the worst version they have heard [8][15]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Reviewer's favorite Ramble; Bobby lays down tasty rhythm and Jerry is deeply into it [8]
- **Me & My Uncle** (1 review): Vocals are almost understated and very good [12]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Scarlet into Fire drops straight into Good Lovin' [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Stayin' Alive Tease**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **Werewolves of London**: rare: 12 archived performances [19]

## The recordings

- **gd78-04-24.sbd.mattman.20605.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 171 min; rated 4.68/5 by 31 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the soundboard sound quality as very good; Reviewer gives the sound 4 out of 5 and calls it nice [7][15]
- **gd1978-04-24.sbd.mccaw.3296.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 4.77/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: The uploader hears too much hiss for this to be an edited master dub; Recording is notably clear and full compared with other newly circulating sources [2][18]
- **gd1978-04-24.sbd.miller.97543.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 172 min; rated 4.67/5 by 21 [3]
- **gd1978-04-24.sbd.miller.32899.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 168 min; rated 4.62/5 by 8 [4]

## Around the show

- First set through Fire is described as flawless, with sweet Donna harmonies on all songs [17]
- Reviewer prefers this Scarlet-Fire over the famous 1977 performances [10]
- Others say the Scarlet-Fire soundboard rivals 5-8-77; reviewer is unsure and wants more listens [12]
- Reviewer thinks this Fire may beat 2-5-78 and is far better than 5-8-77 [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-04-24.sbd.mattman.20605.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard master cassette copied to DAT, cassette, DAT, then CD, EAC and SHN; Mattman remastered from discs David Hollister supplied [1]
- **gd1978-04-24.sbd.mccaw.3296.shnf**: transferred by Mike McCaw; source: MR>?>R>D>Digi96>Soundforge>CDWAV>SHN [2]. Also: Source came on a DBX-encoded reel in 1979, reportedly an edited dub of the master; later transferred to DAT; DAT went through a Digi96 card to hard disk; Sound Forge normalized, anti-aliased and resampled to 44.1 before CD WAV tracking [2]
- **gd1978-04-24.sbd.miller.97543.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat (44.1k) [3]. Also: The disc change in set 2 is seamless, while tape flips fall in Drums and Around [3]
- **gd1978-04-24.sbd.miller.32899.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [4]. Also: This source has no noise reduction applied; tape flips fall during Drums and Around & Around [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Volume 7: Horton Field House, Illinois State, Normal, IL 4/24/78 2013 US 3-CD set](https://eu.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-7-horton-field-house-illinois-state-normal-il-4-24-78-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2532997-790401?view=product-cro-06) [20]
- Poster by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Volume 7: Horton Field House, Illinois State, Normal, IL 4/24/78 2013 US 3-CD set](https://uk.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-7-horton-field-house-illinois-state-normal-il-4-24-78-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2532997-790401) [21]
- Poster by KINGKONG: [Grateful Dead – Dave's Picks, Volume 7 (Horton Field House, Illinois State, Normal, IL • 4/24/78) ■YMR■ | KINGKONG power](https://kkrecords.buyshop.jp/items/74742200) [22]
